title: Enterprise Connectivity: net invoice amount
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this net invoice amount rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: outcome
For net transfer invoice, take the smaller of the approved assessed net and the posting ceiling. Compare that unrounded smaller amount with the minimum invoice amount: below the minimum it is carried without posting; otherwise round it half-up only once to the source-tier monetary precision. Issue exactly one net-only charge for internet outbound transfer, classified as primary service with portfolio pricing and the source UTC month. The distinct statutory tax component is added only after this net charge exists.

## Basis Q&A
| Smaller reviewed amount and posting ceiling | Invoice decision |
| --- | --- |
| Net transfer invoice: Below the minimum before rounding | Carry without posting |
| At least the minimum before rounding | Round once, half-up, and issue the net-only primary internet outbound charge with portfolio pricing for the source UTC month |

## Hypothetical calculation
Assume a hypothetical reviewed net USD 80, posting ceiling USD 60, minimum invoice USD 2 and two-decimal precision. The invoice amount is USD 60. If their smaller amount were USD 1.999, it would carry without a posting; rounding that amount upward before testing the minimum would change the decision.
